name: Global Ocean Biogeochemical Model hindcast simulations (CESM-ETHZ and FESOM-REcoM)
model_or_instrument: CESM-ETHZ and FESOM-REcoM forced with JRA-55 / JRA55-do v1.3
resolution: CESM-ETHZ: 1.125° lon x 0.27°-0.53° lat, 60 vertical layers; FESOM-REcoM: 1° (refined), 46 vertical layers

scales.note: Global ocean biogeochemical models (CESM-ETHZ and FESOM-REcoM) forced by JRA55-do, analyzed on monthly output over 1990-2023.
